attacks.name: Reminiscence: Threnodian - Leviathan - Echo Skill
expressions:
Summon a Collapsing Horizon, dealing two instances of 72.80% Havoc DMG to the nearby enemies and obtaining the Core of Collapse for 15s.
While it lasts, Core of Collapse deals 24.57% Havoc DMG when the active Resonator in the team deals damage. This effect can be triggered once every 0.5s, up to 8. Enemies with Havoc Bane take 100% more DMG from this effect.
The Resonator with this Echo equipped in the main slot gains 12.00% Havoc DMG Bonus and 12.00% Resonance Liberation DMG Bonus.
CD: 25s
